events.title: Is Palantir Technologies a Buy After Its Explosive Q1 2026 Earnings?
events.body: PLTR's explosive Q1 shows surging revenue, margins, and AI demand, but capacity limits and rising competition complicate the bullish case.

events.title: TT Q1 Deep Dive: Data Center Momentum and Record Backlog Support Upbeat Outlook
events.body: HVAC company Trane (NYSE:TT) reported Q1 CY2026 results topping the market’s revenue expectations, with sales up 6% year on year to $4.97 billion. Its non-GAAP profit of $2.63 per share was 3.9% above analysts’ consensus estimates.

events.title: All buildings will have behind-the-meter power eventually: Trane CEO
events.body: Smart systems will be a universal feature, too, David Regnery said on Trane Technologies’ first-quarter earrings call yesterday.
